title: Creamy Garlic Chicken Pasta
description: A comforting weeknight pasta with tender chicken and a silky garlic cream sauce.
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 120 ml pasta water before draining.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked, reaching 74°C (165°F) internally.
Reduce heat to medium, add garlic, and stir for 30 seconds.
Add cream and Parmesan, stirring gently until smooth. Loosen with reserved pasta water as needed.
Toss with pasta, season, and garnish with parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Fluffy Blueberry Pancakes
description: Soft homemade pancakes bursting with blueberries, perfect for a slow morning.
steps: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk milk, egg, and melted butter separately, then fold into dry ingredients just until combined.
Heat a lightly greased skillet over medium heat and pour 60 ml batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles appear, flip, and cook until golden and cooked through.

title: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Golden edges, tender centers, and plenty of chocolate chips.
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Cream butter and sugars until fluffy. Mix in egg and vanilla.
Stir flour, baking soda, and salt together, then combine with wet mixture. Fold in chocolate chips.
Scoop dough into 2-tablespoon portions, spaced apart on baking sheet.
Bake 10–12 minutes until edges are golden. Cool on tray for 5 minutes before transferring.
